card.name: Advice to male patients on contraception
card.fires_on: The word 'use' or 'to' right after 'Advise males (with female partners of reproductive potential) to' in contraception instructions. It also fires on words in the same male-directed advice sentence.

modes.label: Male contraception advice
modes.description: The verb or 'to' after an instruction to males with female partners to use contraception.
modes.example: Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential to<< use>> effective contraception during treatment with GAVRETO

modes.label: Male reference in general text
modes.description: A word after a male possessive in ordinary web text, such as a family member.
modes.example: and his<< brother>> offered Tatar language lessons

card.writes: It pushes toward female pronouns such as herself, she and her and away from male ones, which fits the female partner mentioned in the text.
card.plain: It lights up when the label tells male patients with female partners to use contraception, anticipating a reference to the woman.
